name: Climbing Card Swiper
description: Coverflow card swiper of tilted polaroid-style photo cards on a dark stage. The active card straightens, brightens and reveals its caption with a wipe.
contents: Looping row of polaroid-style cards, each with a photo, handwritten title and caption
behavior: Swiper coverflow effect with centered, looping slides and grab cursor
Inactive cards are tilted and dimmed, the active card straightens and brightens
Caption reveals by a clip-path wipe on the active card
Slides per view adapts across breakpoints
editableByProps: Slides: images, titles, captions, alt text
Background color, fonts, card size, coverflow rotation and depth

needsCodeEdit.change: Change slides per view at each screen width
needsCodeEdit.where: breakpoints object in the Swiper options

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card paper color or shadow

fixed: Loads Caveat and Schibsted Grotesk from Google Fonts through link tags
Stage is at least full viewport height with vertical padding
Loops infinitely and needs enough slides to fill the loop
